Rage Against the Machine took some time out of the studio in 1994 and 1995 to travel to Europe and play some festival shows . Throughout this tour , Rage Against The Machine played at some of Europe 's major music festivals , including the Rock am Ring and Rock im Park Festivals in Germany and the Glastonbury Festival in Glastonbury , England , respectively . Live at Finsbury Park is a video album by the American rap metal band Rage Against the Machine . The concert was recorded on the 6th June 2010 at Finsbury Park in London .
